plain: Speaking like an oracle; sounding wise and final.

webster.text: Uttering oracles; as an oracular tongue.

example.quote: But, after all, whatever veneration might be entertained for the body of men who formed our constitution, the sense of that body could never be regarded as the oracular guide in the expounding the constitution.
example.cite: James Madison, Speech in Congress on the Jay Treaty, Apr. 6, 1796
